title: Runner interaction record
description: Runner observations. record_type distinguishes a logical interaction from a phase marker such as E2's agent-stop and restart boundaries; markers carry no interaction fields because they describe no interaction.

topology.description: E0/E2 use same-domain; E1 and the Task 04 readiness runs use federated; E3 uses the two frozen benchmark topology names local and federated (experimental-protocol.md 18).

request_class.description: E1: cross_domain or same_domain. Tracked separately so a federated failure cannot hide behind same-domain successes.

initiated_monotonic_ns.description: T0. One monotonic clock in one process (experimental-protocol.md §10).

completed_monotonic_ns.description: T3, stamped at the start of the callback for the matching ACK.

workload.description: E3 only. Workload A or Workload B (experimental-protocol.md 21, 22).

block_id.description: E3 only. Paired run block, the formal replication unit (29).

concurrency.description: E3 only. Maximum outstanding logical interactions, C.

message_body_bytes.description: Encoded UTF-8 length of the request body. E3 freezes it at 256 (17).

phase.description: E3 only. Which period of the run this interaction belongs to. A label, not the estimator: window membership is derived at analysis from completed_monotonic_ns against window_start_ns and window_end_ns (22).

window_start_ns.description: Canonical name. No parallel name is used anywhere (22).

window_end_ns.description: Canonical name. No parallel name is used anywhere (22).

live_recovery_episode.description: Set when the ACK reached the sender through a live gap-recovery episode, so the RTT carries pagination round trips.

send_errcode.description: Matrix errcode when the homeserver refused the send. M_LIMIT_EXCEEDED is recorded, never retried away (28).

late_ack_monotonic_ns.description: An ACK observed after the frozen per-interaction timeout expired. Preserved as evidence; it does not change the outcome, which experimental-protocol.md 11 fixes at termination.
